uroboros1205/prismfy-search.reason: The retained search client transforms arguments into an API body and branches on returned error/raw-output states.

features.reason: The client converts page to a number and constructs a body with optional timeRange/domain fields.

evidence.quote:
# Build JSON body
  local body
  body=$(jq -n \
    --arg q "$query" \
    --argjson engines "$engines_json" \
    --arg lang "$lang" \
    --arg page "$page" \
    '{query: $q, engines: $engines, language: $lang, page: ($page | tonumber)}')

  [[ -n "$time_range" ]] && body=$(echo "$body" | jq --arg t "$time_range" '. + {timeRange: $t}')
  [[ -n "$domain"     ]] && body=$(echo "$body" | jq --arg d "$domain"     '. + {domain: $d}')

jernejcicorbin-hub/claim-verifier.reason: The own verifier extracts bounded deduplicated claims and passes each to its retained single-claim helper.

features.reason: Input text is sentence-split, trimmed, filtered, deduplicated and capped before verification.

evidence.quote:
# Basic claim extraction heuristic: split by sentence separators, trim, dedupe, keep non-trivial lines.
mapfile -t claims < <(
  echo "$text" \
  | tr '\n' ' ' \
  | sed 's/[!?]/./g' \
  | tr '.' '\n' \
  | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' \
  | awk 'length($0) > 20' \
  | awk '!seen[$0]++' \
  | head -n "$max_claims"
